name: Foreman Dougie

intro.text: I worked in the old smelter, thirty years of heat and noise. Now I run the dam tours. It is cooler, and the noise is mostly me.

win: That was a fair fight. I have had worse in the canteen.
after: They made aluminium here by the ton. It went to aeroplanes. Nothing here has gone to an aeroplane since, which suits the hens.
